description: Defines classes and interfaces for managing a receive buffer pool in a physical layer context, including reservation, housekeeping, and configuration.

classes.name: rx_buffer_pool
classes.description: Interface for managing a pool of receive buffers, including reservation and slot housekeeping.

classes.name: rx_buffer_pool_controller
classes.description: Interface for controlling the receive buffer pool, including access to the pool and stopping it.

methods.name: reserve
methods.description: Reserves a buffer for a specific identifier and codeblock count, returning a unique buffer if successful.

methods.name: run_slot
methods.description: Performs housekeeping tasks for the current slot.

methods.name: get_pool
methods.description: Returns the reference to the actual buffer pool.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the buffer pool, waiting for all buffers to be unlocked.
